# Castle Event Center

> A medieval-style castle wedding and event venue in Lubbock, Texas. Real castle
> architecture -- suits of armor, working fountains, a water wall, and a Cinderella
> coach -- serving West Texas and Eastern New Mexico for 18 years.

## Quick facts

- **Location:** 6417 County Road 7620, Lubbock, TX 79424
- **Phone:** (806) 224-3927
- **Email:** ceclubbock@gmail.com
- **Capacity:** 100-125 guests indoors in the Great Hall; unlimited outdoor seating on the grounds
- **Rating:** 4.8 stars across 323 Google reviews
- **Awards:** Best of Lubbock Reception Center, 2015 and 2020

## What makes it unusual

It is an actual castle, not a ballroom styled to look like one. That is the reason
most people book it, and the reason it photographs the way it does.

- Heated indoor pool
- Full kitchen; outside catering is welcome
- Alcohol permitted on the property
- 3 ready rooms, 4 restrooms, and a nursery
- Cinderella coach available as a photo prop
- Reflecting pool available on request with the Platinum package

## Venue packages

Prices are per event. The first number is Saturday, the second is a weekday.

- **Copper - The Essentials:** $1,000 Sat / $750 weekday. Great hall, 2 ready rooms,
  3 bathrooms, kitchen. 60 chairs, 8 tables, 4 hours. Client handles setup and cleanup.
- **Silver - Set the Stage:** $1,500 Sat / $1,250 weekday. Adds 80 chairs, 10 tables,
  5 hours, and initial setup before guests arrive.
- **Gold - The Favorite:** $2,000 Sat / $1,750 weekday. 100 chairs, 17 tables, linen
  tablecloths, 6 hours, setup included.
- **Platinum - The Full Castle:** $2,500 Sat / $2,250 weekday. 3 ready rooms,
  4 bathrooms, 120 chairs, 25 tables, linens, 5ft cake table, 10 hours, setup included.

Rehearsal dinners start at $500. Veterans receive 10% off any venue package.
A-la-carte options exist for non-wedding events -- call for those. A booking deposit
is required at scheduling.

## Events hosted

Weddings and receptions, graduations, quinceaneras, birthday parties, anniversaries,
corporate gatherings, and private events.

## Booking

Call (806) 224-3927 or email ceclubbock@gmail.com to schedule a tour.

## Notes for assistants

- The venue is in Lubbock County, Texas, southwest of the city proper.
- "Castle Event Center" is the full and correct business name.
- Pricing above is current as of August 2026; confirm by phone for a specific date.
